newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China policy maker makes secret Hong Kong visit.
newsitem.headline: China policy maker makes secret Hong Kong visit.

text.p: China's top policy maker, Lu Ping, paid a secret visit to Hong Kong just 11 days before the territory reverts to Chinese rule.

Lu, the director of Hong Kong and Macau Affairs Office, arrived at the territory on Thursday and had a "working dinner" with future Hong Kong leader Tung Chee-hwa, the post-colonial chief's office said in a statement on Friday.
The statement said the two held discussions on the arrangements for the ceremony marking Britain handing Hong Kong over to China and the inauguration of the territory's future government.
Hong Kong, a British colony for 156 years, reverts to Chinese rule at midnight on June 30.
Lu would stay in Hong Kong for a few days before returning to Beijing, it said.
